stitch_shortlist.author: 9news
stitch_shortlist.claim: 9News: sunscreen on children could be harmful (hormone-disrupting chemical)

pitch.the_claim: A national news clip: "a new study has revealed that sunscreen on children could be harmful, due to a hormone-disrupting chemical" — 745K views in 3.3d, 494 comments. The study (Environmental Science & Technology, Sep 4) found 80% of Queensland kids' pooled urine samples over the German homosalate guidance level, kids 2.6–24× adult levels.
pitch.why_it_stitches: The scariest possible framing (news outlet + kids + hormones) with the most dangerous possible takeaway (skip sunscreen). Rising 226K/day, comments disproportionate, punches UP at a broadcaster — and it's exactly the one she went on record about in 2023.
pitch.your_fit: Her 2023 line (46.7K TT): "if you are a child, if you are pregnant, if you are breastfeeding or if you have a hormone-sensitive cancer… this is the list of sunscreens you should avoid — I avoid putting these on my children," naming oxybenzone/avobenzone/homosalate as potential hormone mimickers. Repeat needs a NEW angle: the study numbers + the hand-to-mouth route (kids eat it) + "don't quit sunscreen — switch the filter".
angles: empathy-first: parents panicking tonight — here's the 10-second fix (zinc/titanium for kids)
"you want me to WHAT?" — skip sunscreen on kids? no: here's the list I don't put on mine
switch-don't-quit: mineral SPF + hats + shade; the chemical filters are the adults' problem

pitch.your_fit: Her tinea versicolor post (1.29M IG + 426K TT, 12.6d): "tinea versicolor is often mistaken for age spots… appearance becomes more obvious after the summer due to sweating and tanning" — the transcript index has no PMH position yet, so the PMH half needs her take; the TV half is hers.

news.headline: Dissolvable microneedle patch for basal cell heads toward a pivotal trial
news.summary: Medicus' Phase 2 SkinJect report (Sep 10): the 200-µg patch picked as the pivotal dose for an FDA-authorized registrational study in Gorlin-syndrome BCC; nodular BCC still needs a partner.
news.her_angle: "Could a patch replace surgery for basal cell?" — a Mohs surgeon reads the data: promising, not yet.
